Laurie Theurer

About

I’m originally from southern California, growing up just a couple miles from the beach. Shortly after graduating from university, I traveled to Loei, Thailand for two years to volunteer as an English teacher with the U.S. Peace Corps. Not long after returning to California, I packed up my belongings and have lived in Switzerland ever since. I work as a freelancer in the pharmaceutical and medical device industry and write fiction, non-fiction, flash fiction, short stories, poetry…and everything in-between…every chance I get.
I’m extremely honored that my first book “Swisstory: The Untold, Bloody, and Absolutely Real History of Switzerland” won the 2020 SCBWI Crystal Kite Award.
“50 Amazing Swiss Women: True Stories You Should Know About” was a collaboration with four talented authors and one incredible illustrator. It was released on 7 February 2021 to coincide with the 50-year anniversary of Swiss women’s right to vote.
“50 Amazing Swiss Immigrants: True Stories You Should Know About” was also a collaboration and came next. It was released in September 2023.
The final book in the series, “50 Amazing Young Swiss: Fearless Dreamers” will be published on 27 August 2026 and we could not be more excited!

ABOUT

2020 Crystal Kite Winners Michael Meister created over 150 illustrations for this book. Swisstory: The amazing, bloody and utterly true history of Switzerland By Laurie Theurer and Michael Meister Published by Bergli books
Translated from the English by Gerlinde Schermer-Rauwolf and Robert A. Weiss.
Here finally comes the true story of Switzerland for clever children and everyone who has remained children at heart: We learn how dukes were sneakily slaughtered by peasants and how innocent 'witches' were hanged. It's about buried gold, female climbers, and of course murderous cows. ‹Swisstory› does not tell fictional stories about Heidi and Wilhelm Tell, but the Swiss story from the mountain people of bygone times to women's suffrage. It is witty illustrated by the Swiss artist and king of editions Michael Meister (“ The Big Monster Book of Switzerland ”). ‹Swisstory› is monstrous, captivating, gruesome - and utterly true! For children from 9 to 99. In German and English edition.
